attributes.action: Claim back our country and cost of living.
attributes.background: Cease the £5.7m cost of housing migrants in hotels each day. Instead, use this money to correctly deport & invest this money into border force in mind of preventing any further immigrant's from entering the country. This the same as what would happen to a uk person illegally entering Europe.

rejection.details:
What your petition is seeking seems to be something on which we already have a petition open, which you may wish to sign:

Immediately close all asylum hotels & deport all illegal migrants living there
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/778710
